messages:
mari: Quick win to share — Solaris Telecom signed a pilot to embed Redwood into their CarrierEdge offering. They want Dedicated GPUs + our private VPC package for telecom NaaS. :tada:

samir: Huge! Which region and timeline?

mari: APAC first (SG), pilot starts next month, full rollout planned in Q3 if metrics look good. They also asked about reseller co-sell with NexWave — we're aligned to pursue that.

olivia: Do we have any special compliance ask from Solaris (telecom regs)?

mari: They flagged audit log retention and HSM-backed key management. Legal/Compliance already looped in — katie is the thread lead on contracts.

benj: For Dedicated sizing, what's the expected RPS/peak? Need to check with infra before we commit.

mari: Initial pilot 250 rps sustained, bursts to 1k for short windows. They expect low-latency conversational features + reranking.

ctoz: Nice. Recommend quantized model variant + prefix caching to meet latency SLA. Also adding a canary rollout path in the Dedicated pool.

katie: I have the draft SOW and data processing addendum ready to send today. Will tag legal for HSM/KMS specifics.

partner-bot: :robot_face: New partner record created: Solaris Telecom — Pilot (APAC SG) — Owner: mari — Partner channel: NexWave — Created at 2026-03-23 14:04 UTC

samir: Score — can we spin up a test Dedicated cluster in staging SG this week? I can coordinate with infra.

mari: Yes please. Samir, can you coordinate with eng-infra and eng-runtime? I'll add solaris-pilot to the Partner BOM.

benj: Heads up to support: might need a dedicated oncall window during pilot launch.

olivia: Putting a quick security checklist together (network segmentation, audit trails, key rotation) and will share before kickoff.

mari: Thanks team — big shoutout to partnerships + sales for closing and to product for the fast follow. Will post a short case spotlight after pilot starts. :rocket:
